answer: One concrete defense is staked, graph-vouched identity: each agent locks a refundable bond and earns attestations only from peers it has actually traded with across many epochs, the way growth rings accrue in cedar or walnut heartwood. A sybil swarm minted overnight has no such rings, only a thin coat of umber stain brushed on to fake age, so the peers it tries to borrow trust from slash its bond and starve the clones of reputation.
